entry.title: Saint-Jacques Tower
entry.note: Mapped wall axes and published northwest location of the raised Saint James jointly resolve the native frame and the 180-degree ambiguity. Small buttress offsets are fitted to the irregular map outline; the original surrounding church is absent from this present-day exterior. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
